subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the following sentence.

Everything in the mansion was in __great confusion__ after the robbery.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Everything in the mansion was in great confusion"** suggests a state of disorder and chaos. It implies that things were scattered or disorganized, likely as a result of the mentioned robbery.
 
 
• **Example: **After the surprise party, the entire house was in great confusion, with decorations and utensils scattered all around.
 
 
 
• The idiom **"Pell-mell"** means in a confused, rushed, or disorderly manner. It perfectly describes the state of the mansion after the robbery, indicating that everything was in disarray. (अव्यवस्थित रूप से)
 
 
• **Example: **The students ran pell-mell out of the classroom when the bell rang, leaving papers and books everywhere.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Pell-mell" accurately captures the essence of the underlined segment in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pick holes** (आलोचना करना): To look for mistakes or flaws in something with the intention of criticizing.
 
 
• **Example:** Instead of offering constructive feedback, he just picks holes in everyone's work.
 
 
 
• **Turn over a new leaf** (नई शुरुआत करना): To make a fresh start or to begin again in a better way.
 
 
• **Example:** After spending years in a job she hated, she decided to turn over a new leaf and pursue her passion for art.
 
 
 
• **Damp squib** (निराशाजनक): Something that is less impressive or exciting than expected.
 
 
• **Example:** The much-anticipated movie turned out to be a damp squib, disappointing fans and critics alike.
 
 

39:Ta7f,

The correct answer is 'Option 2'
